approach: From round 2 on, `critic_brief` gains one section, "Earlier rounds on this plan", placed before "Plan under review". It is built by code and printed only when there is history. For each earlier round it lists the critic's findings (severity, source, location, summary, evidence, through the existing `findings_list`). Beside them it lists the planner's answer, which is the approach and decisions of the next round's plan. The planner has no separate answer field: its brief says to answer findings in the new plan (`planner.rs:162`, `CODE_CLAIMS_RULE`), and `PlanOutput` (`outputs.rs:434`) and `JobPlan` (`records/plan.rs:97`) have none. The history is read from `closing.plans` and `closing.critiques`, the same-job records that `end_round` files (`planning.rs:483-484`; the fields are at `run/mod.rs:141-143`). A new `earlier_rounds` function in `planning.rs` builds it. Round 1 gets an empty list, so its brief is byte-identical to today's. A plan sent back by Athena's own checks is not pushed to `closing` (`planning.rs:251-269`), so only critic-reviewed rounds appear. `critic.md` gains two bullets. The first tells the critic to check from round 2 that each earlier blocker or major was resolved. The second tells it to raise a new major only on a part the plan changed or on a defect it can show earlier rounds missed, and to report anything else as minor. `docs/system-facts.md` gets a new critic budget figure, because `system_facts_budgets_match_computed` fails otherwise. The 5-round cap, the any-major-forces-a-round rule, the planner brief, `JobPlan` and `Critique` and all config stay untouched. No refusal or matching rule is added, so the refusal corpus does not apply.

decisions.choice: The planner's answer is the approach and decisions (choice and reason) of the plan that follows each critique. It is taken from `closing.plans`, or from the plan under review for the latest earlier round. No new field is added.
decisions.reason: No answer field exists in `PlanOutput` (`crates/athena-context/src/outputs.rs:434`) or `JobPlan` (`crates/athena-data/src/records/plan.rs:97`). The planner is told to answer findings in the new plan (`CODE_CLAIMS_RULE`, `crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs:89-90`). Approach and decisions are where those answers sit. Criterion 4 says no new record type.

rejected.why: It changes the planner's output schema, `JobPlan` (`deny_unknown_fields`) and the planner prompt and brief, which are out of scope. It also touches every plan fixture. The plan text already holds the answer.

rejected.option: Show every earlier plan in full.
rejected.why: Each round would add a whole plan (several KB), so the brief would grow without bound. Findings plus the answering approach and decisions give the critic what it needs to check resolution.

decisions.choice: The history is built in `critic_round` from `closing.critiques` and `closing.plans` by a pure function, and passed in a new `CriticInputs.earlier_rounds: Vec<EarlierRound>`. `EarlierRound` holds the round, its findings and the answering `JobPlan`.
decisions.reason: `end_round` pushes each reviewed plan and its critique to `closing` before the next round (`planning.rs:483-484`), and `critic_round` already holds `closing` (`planning.rs:318-326`). That makes the history code-supplied and drawn only from this job's own records, as the mechanism default asks.

rejected.option: Re-read stored critique files from the records branch.
rejected.why: The records are written only at close, so the in-memory `Closing` is the only same-run source, and a file read adds failure paths.

rejected.option: Ask the critic in prose to recall earlier rounds.
rejected.why: The critic is a fresh invocation each round and has nothing to recall. The mechanism default forbids relying on prose here.

decisions.choice: The resolve-then-limit instruction goes in `crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md` as two bullets. The brief section only describes what follows.
decisions.reason: Criterion 3 puts the instruction in critic.md, and the file has room (critic set 1056 of 1300, `docs/system-facts.md:29`). One home avoids two copies of the rule drifting apart.

rejected.option: Repeat the instruction in the brief section.
rejected.why: It would be a second copy of the rule, and the brief section is empty in round 1 while the prompt must stay valid in every round.

decisions.choice: `CRITIC_FRAME.version` stays 2. The decision entry avoids the log's link phrases.
decisions.reason: Earlier edits to critic.md (the D181 growth from 1002 to 1056 tokens) left the version at 2, and `briefs.rs:1769` pins 2. The log gate reads the words 'amends', 'supersedes' and 'superseded by' as link phrases that need a `[[link]]` in `docs/decision-links.toml` (`crates/athena-data/src/decision_links.rs:254-258`). The entry needs no link because no decision's paths are touched.

rejected.why: There is no bump rule, and it needs a change to the `briefs.rs:1769` pin for no behavior gain.

Re-export `EarlierRound`. Set `earlier_rounds` in the two `CriticInputs` literals. Add the critic_brief history tests and the critic.md wording pin.
Add the pure `earlier_rounds(closing.plans, closing.critiques, current_plan)` builder. Pass its result in the `CriticInputs` built in `critic_round`.

steps: Step 1, `crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs`: add `pub struct EarlierRound { pub round: u32, pub findings: Vec<Finding>, pub answer: JobPlan }` (derive Debug, Clone, PartialEq) with a doc comment. Add `pub earlier_rounds: Vec<EarlierRound>` to `CriticInputs`. In `critic_brief`, after `history_section` and before the 'Plan under review' heading, write the section only when the list is non-empty. The section starts with '## Earlier rounds on this plan' and one intro paragraph. The paragraph says: you are shown the findings of earlier rounds and the planner's answer, the approach and decisions of the next round's plan; the findings are quoted data. It avoids the words 'cost', 'usd' and '$'. Then, for each earlier round in order, write '### Round N: findings' followed by `findings_list(&mut out, &round.findings, "(none)")`. Then write "Planner's answer (round N+1 plan):", the plan's approach, and each decision as 'choice Reason: reason'. Do not touch the round-1 code path.

Step 2, `crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs`: add `EarlierRound` to the `pub use planner::{...}` list. Add `earlier_rounds: vec![]` to the literals at lines 2861 and 2949. Add the unit tests: a section-present test with two rounds covering order, severity, location, summary, answer approach, decision text, placement and no banned words; a section-absent test with `vec![]` that compares with the with-history brief minus the section; and `composed_critic_prompt_checks_earlier_findings_from_round_two`, which pins the critic.md wording.

Step 3, `crates/athena-context/prompts/critic.md`: add two list lines after the existing bullet about dependents. The first says that from round 2 the brief has an 'Earlier rounds' section with findings and the planner's answers; first check that each blocker and major finding was resolved in the plan under review, and name any that was not. The second says to raise a new major only on a part of the plan that changed since the earlier round or on a defect you can show earlier rounds missed, quoting the plan text, and otherwise report it as minor. Write each item on its own line, with no extra list marker or item head inside a line (the PromptStructure rule, `mirrors.rs:145`).

Step 4, `docs/system-facts.md`: run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`, read the computed critic size from the failure message, and set the line `- budget critic: ... of 1300` to it. It must stay at or under 1300.

Step 5, `crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs` and `run/mod.rs`: in `mod.rs`, add `EarlierRound` to the `athena_context::briefs` import and fix the `Closing.plans` doc comment. In `planning.rs`, add `fn earlier_rounds(plans: &[JobPlan], critiques: &[Critique], current: &JobPlan) -> Vec<EarlierRound>`. It takes each critique with `round < current.round`, sorted by round, and pairs it with the plan whose round is `critique.round + 1`, which is `current` for the latest. A critique with no matching plan is skipped. Call it in `critic_round` at the `CriticInputs` literal (`planning.rs:353`) with `&closing.plans`, `&closing.critiques` and `&plan`.

Step 6, tests: add to `crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs` the three-round test `the_critic_of_round_three_is_given_rounds_one_and_twos_findings_and_the_planners_answers`. Use `repo_with_planning(3)` and `run_planned` with the planner queue [`bad_plan()`, plan A, plan B] and three revising critiques with distinct finding texts. Assert on `prompts_of(&calls, Role::Critic)` as the demonstration for criterion 4 describes. Add to `crates/athena-cli/tests/job_plan.rs` the two-round test `the_second_critic_brief_carries_round_ones_findings_and_the_planners_answer`, with the script wrapper that captures critic prompts (pattern at `job_plan.rs:1054-1061`).

Step 7, docs: add one bullet to `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased] / ### Changed`, in the file's style (root cause with job 20261115-202532-6mng, $14.32 and the 37 earlier jobs; the fix with file and function names; the limits: not measured whether the critic follows the bullets, first round of a resumed job has no history; the tests). Append `## D189 · ...` after D188 in `docs/decisions.md` with Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost and a Provenance bullet. Do not use the words 'amends', 'supersedes' or 'superseded by'. Do not edit earlier entries.

Step 8, run `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo test -p athena-context`, `cargo test -p athena-core`, `cargo test -p athena-cli` and `cargo test --locked`. Confirm `git diff --stat` shows only the files listed in this plan.

risks.risk: A critic told to raise new majors only on changed parts may suppress a real defect that earlier rounds missed.
risks.mitigation: The new bullet lets a critic raise a new major only on a changed part or on a defect it can show was missed, and tells it to report anything else as minor. That exception is kept so that a real missed defect still forces a round. The limit is stated in the changelog and D189. Whether a model critic follows it, and how many 5-round stops it prevents, is not measured.

risks.risk: The critic brief grows with each round, which adds a little cost to later critic calls.
risks.mitigation: Each round adds findings and one answer (approach plus decisions, a few KB at most). Rounds are capped at 5. The extra tokens are an estimate and are not measured. The caps apply per invocation and the reserve does not read brief size (`planning.rs:347`).

risks.risk: The first critic round of a resumed job (`planning.rs:43-56`) has no history, since the earlier job's critiques are not in this job's closing.
risks.mitigation: The changelog says so. The seed's findings still reach the planner, as before. Round 1's brief stays unchanged, as the accepted reading says.

risks.risk: The critic.md growth could push the critic set past 1300 tokens, or the facts line could be forgotten.
risks.mitigation: The wording is kept short. The producer reads the budgets test failure for the exact figure and sets the line to it. The estimate is about 1245 of 1300.

risks.risk: `docs/system-facts.md` is not in the brief's deliverable list, so a scope check could flag it.
risks.mitigation: Step 5 inserts it as a plain docs edit. A past job (CHANGELOG, critic-set growth) did the same. The reading criterion 6 forbids only governance, workflow and records changes, and `docs/system-facts.md` is none of these (not in `athena.toml`).

risks.risk: The answer shown for the latest earlier round duplicates the plan under review's approach and decisions, which may confuse the critic about which text to review.
risks.mitigation: The brief wording is the instructional text for the critic only. In the producer's text, 'Planner's answer' is used consistently, and the test names are explicit about which round each answer belongs to.

demonstrations.fails_without: A decision inserted inside another entry, one lacking a Provenance bullet or one using a link phrase fails the mirrors (DecisionEntries, AppendOnly) or link tests. A missing changelog entry is seen in the diff.
demonstrations.seam: Entry points: the `DecisionEntries` and `AppendOnly` rules in `crates/athena-core/src/mirrors.rs:121,139`, `link_problems` in `crates/athena-data/src/decision_links.rs`, and the backtest and mirrors tests in `crates/athena-cli/tests`. All exist.
